title: The adversarial review's structured result (IP-MC17-007 AC-5)
description: The contract a review's ledger record carries beside its prose, so a gate reads states and never parses sentences. The ledger schema's workOrder entries mirror this shape one to one; mc17.test.js holds the two equal. The seam: in, the target asset ids; out, the review asset id, the ledger record number and this work order. mc-adv-review-v17 is the first caller; the DevyonQ adversarial-review gate and button are the second.
